profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. operates a Spanish-market site for its fully electric vehicle range, which the company describes as making real since 2014 what the world calls the future. The site presents three models, the G6, G9 and P7⁺, which it says combine artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the SEPA 2.0 800-volt electric platform. According to the company, that platform allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three models carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160,000 km.

The site also carries financing offers. For the G6 RWD Standard Range it lists a cash price of 41.122,71€ and a financed price of 37.522,71€, and for the G9 RWD Standard Range a cash price of 56.590,30€. The financing is offered by Open Bank, S.A. and is subject to study and approval. The site names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the party responsible for handling data submitted through its contact form.

XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under CIK 0001810997 and trading under the ticker XPEV. No litigation involving the company is listed.
